limits.price: Bid OHLC; Ask = Bid + row spread * point. Long enters Ask/exits Bid; short enters Bid/exits Ask.
limits.gap_stop: Stop already crossed at opening fills at adverse liquidation-side open; otherwise a within-bar hit fills at stop. Scheduled exits occur at opening after gap stops.
limits.marking: Proxy equity marked at each global observed bar open/close with liquidation-side marks; disclose that native intrabar DD can be higher.
limits.commission_limit: No historical commission field in supplied snapshots; proxy is optimistic for omitted commissions. Native complete costs are required for a survivor.
limits.swap: Use immutable numeric MT5 modes and quoted swap rates; mode 1 points -> USD via point/tick_size*tick_value, mode 2 money in symbol base -> direct USD only when base USD. Charge server-midnight boundaries after broker weekdays held, triple according to the day ending at that boundary; no extra weekend charges. Snapshot swaps are descriptive proxy approximations, not historical rates.
limits.swap_stress: Same snapshot swap as actual; doubled-cost stress refers to doubled spread. Report spread and swap separately.
limits.midquote_spread_stress: Subtract one additional direction-specific entry-plus-exit half-spread burden, equivalent to doubling the observed bid/ask friction about midprices. Same actual-balance-sized fills; native historical-cost authority remains mandatory.
limits.spread_stress: Binding benchmark-comparable proxy stress subtracts one extra observed direction-specific spread burden: entry spread for a long, exit spread for a short, valued in USD. Also report the original extra half-entry-plus-half-exit midquote stress; both stressed profits must pass each positive/profit development gate.
limits.equity_time_order: All source raw H4 timestamps must lie on the same 14400-second grid. Process the whole opening batch before any current-bar high/low, then all intrabar closes and the close mark before the next global opening. Off-grid source is an engineering correction, not an implicit lookahead approximation.
limits.margin: Source snapshots lack exact historical margin rates. Proxy is a risk-limited gross-admission screen; it does not invent a CFD leverage margin formula or certify native fills. Any survivor must acquire attributable full margin contracts and use native broker admission before victory.
